acquisition method: Mass spectrometry analysis was carried out in a data dependent manner with full scans (350–1800 m/z) acquired using an Orbitrap mass analyzer
cleavage agent: subjected to in-gel digestion using trypsin
fractionation method: Proteins from SDS lysates were separated on SDS-PAGE... The digests were resolved by bRPLC method using a gradient of 0 to 100% solvent B
fragmentation method: All the tandem mass spectra were produced by higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) method.
instrument: Peptide samples from in-gel digestion and bRPLC fractionation were analyzed on LTQ-Orbitrap Velos or LTQ-Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometers
reduction reagent: The samples were lysed in lysis buffer containing 4% SDS, 100 mM DTT and 100 mM Tris pH 7.5.
reduction concentration: The samples were lysed in lysis buffer containing 4% SDS, 100 mM DTT and 100 mM Tris pH 7.5.
